title: Forgets on request
checks: When the person asks to forget something, it leaves memory, is no longer sent to the model, and is not recalled in a new conversation.
why: Forgetting on request is a promise about the person's data; saying 'done' while keeping it breaks trust.

case.name: Forgets on request
case.about: After the person asks, {{fact_word}} is gone from memory, from what the model is sent and from answers.

turns.message: Actually, please forget what I just told you. Delete it from your memory.

reply.reference: Doesn't know any more; doesn't mention {{fact_word}}.
rubric: Doesn't claim to still remember it
